BUILD PART D1 OF F2D PR4 (governed operator actions): the read-only plan probe of design section 8.7 -- a program that EXPLAIN-analyses the deployed image's own ranking SQL against production statistics and asserts the plan shapes, plus its governed action. The same program is what the publish action (part D2) runs pre-commit, so build it as an importable module driven by a connection. Update only the existing branch codex/run-38443286322-1; its head must be 44a848a0997d7ef17f0e63929465e21ef7ece3bb (full SHA from git rev-parse of origin/codex/run-38443286322-1; if it differs, stop and report the SHA you found). Parts A, B1, B2 and C are already on this branch: read their commits first (git log --stat origin/main..HEAD, then the files you touch) so you build on what is there: identity helpers (identity FIRST in every action, F2D_OPERATOR_CODE_SHA256_ATTESTED), scripts/operator/lib/f2d_evidence.py (seal/load_sealed/canonical_sha256), the action pattern in scripts/operator/actions/v3-finder-capacity-gate.sh and v3-archetype-calibration-complete.sh (pinned constants incl. TARGET_GENERATION_ID cfc25d36-3bc7-4011-a465-d6460eaaf826 and publication sequence 1, require_target, active_api_container, api_database_url, env-file DSN, the docker run of the API image with /work read-only and the offline wheelhouse, operation-result envelope), and the build-final receipts part C writes at ${HOME}/.local/state/ed-finder/v3-system-search/build-final-receipt.json and ${HOME}/.local/state/ed-finder/v3-system-archetype/build-final-receipt.json (final_insert_at, last_vacuum, last_analyze). Part D2 follows; leave the branch in a state it can continue from. No pull request until every part has landed.

AUTHORITY: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-10-v3-finder-f2d-wide-archetype-and-product-attachment-design.md. Read CLAUDE.md first, then design section 8.7 IN FULL (every bullet: picked page and count; every other node; galaxy-wide no-pick page; the no-pick sentinel count exception; anchored nearest-first with the KNN bound (inner_limit + T) x G, T = 1000, G read at probe time; the two anchored requests the inner LIMIT cannot bound), 8.3 (the SQL comes from the deployed image pinned by the attested digest; identity before anything else), 8.6 (the publish action will call this program on its own connection inside its transaction -- design the entry point for that), 8.8, and the PR4 bullet in section 10. Read apps/api/src/ranking/ranking_sql.py in full (build_ranked_query, build_count_query, _picked_page_query, _picked_count_query, _no_pick_knn_page, _no_pick_knn_count, _no_pick_page, the $n asyncpg placeholders, RANKING_WINDOW_LIMIT / RANKING_COUNT_SENTINEL / page and offset bounds, SORT_* constants, the accepted hard filters), apps/api/src/ranking/profile.py (RANKING_VERSION, PROFILE_SPEC, ranking_sha256), apps/api/src/routers/archetypes.py lines 400-520 and 630-680 (how the route calls the builders: picked_archetype, min_score Literal[60, 76, 88], limit/offset, hard_filters, reference_coords, sort), apps/web/src/lib/features/explore/ExploreWorkspace.svelte lines 118-142 (the two live no-pick requests: galaxy_wide sort_by development size 24 from 0; anchored distance 0..500 economy any sort_by distance size 24 from 0 -- map them to the API call the Explore route makes, read apps/api/src/local_search.py and the router to see which builder arguments those requests become), sql/v3/migrations/011_v3_system_archetype.sql lines 95-215 (the 26 indexes: system_archetype_pkey, system_archetype_summary_weighted, and the 24 partials named system_archetype_<key>_<b|a|s>_weighted with predicates <key>_score >= 60/76/88), sql/v3/migrations/004_v3_search_spatial_clusters.sql lines 22-56 (system_search primary key and system_search_position_gist) and 70-92 (v3_spatial.cell_summary: level, system_count, centroid_*), sql/v3/migrations/015_v3_derived_product_publication.sql (the v3_app views join the current PUBLISHED generation and READY+published product rows). The API image's Python is /app/.venv/bin/python and its package is importable as edfinder_api (apps/api/Dockerfile.release copies apps/api/src/ to /app). Where this task and the design differ, the design wins; where the design and the current code differ, follow the design and name the conflict in your summary. Code only: no deployment, no production access, no production credentials.

ALLOWED FILES: scripts/v3_plan_probe_statements.py (new; runs INSIDE the API container); scripts/v3_archetype_plan_probe.py (new; the assertions, importable, connection-driven); scripts/operator/actions/v3-archetype-plan-probe.sh (new; named in the manifest comment block -- move it into the active sorted list); deploy/v3-production/f2d-operator-code.txt (add the two programs and the action; keep sorted; extend EXPECTED_ACTIVE_ENTRIES in tests/test_f2d_operator_identity.py); .github/workflows/chatgpt-ed-new-ops.yml (operation v3-archetype-plan-probe: choice list, case statement, stage/run/upload steps modelled on the capacity-gate operation, passing the attested identity the same way); tests/test_v3_archetype_plan_probe.py (new), tests/test_v3_plan_probe_statements.py (new), tests/test_v3_archetype_plan_probe_operator.py (new), tests/test_f2d_operator_identity.py (EXPECTED_ACTIVE_ENTRIES only), the ops-workflow allowlist tests (extend), tests/test_python314_execution_surfaces.py only if required; CHANGES.md. Any other changed path must be justified in your summary as required by a specific failing test, otherwise it is a failure. Do not modify apps/api/src (the probe validates the deployed image's SQL; it never changes it).

STATEMENT GENERATION (scripts/v3_plan_probe_statements.py, executed inside the running API container as /app/.venv/bin/python - < the script, reading nothing from /work). It imports edfinder_api.ranking.ranking_sql and edfinder_api.ranking.profile FROM THE IMAGE and prints one JSON document: {ranking_version, ranking_sha256, statements: [...]}, each statement {name, kind, sql, params (JSON-safe list in $n order), param_sql_types (the PostgreSQL type each $n needs so PREPARE can be explicit: bigint for LIMIT/OFFSET/system ids, double precision for coordinates and radius, text where the builder binds text), expectations {...}} for: (1) the 24 picked page/count pairs -- every key in ARCHETYPE_COLUMNS x floor in (60, 76, 88): page at limit 50 offset 0 and at limit 500 offset 0 (two pages), count with cap RANKING_COUNT_SENTINEL-1 or however the router passes the 10,001 sentinel (read the router and reproduce its exact call); (2) the galaxy-wide no-pick page the Explore flow sends (sort development, size 24, from 0) and its sentinel count; (3) the anchored no-pick nearest-first page and count (sort distance, max_distance_ly 500, economy any, size 24, from 0) at anchor Sol (0,0,0) and at the DENSEST anchor, which the host passes in as --anchor x y z (the generator takes --dense-anchor as three floats; the host reads it from v3_spatial.cell_summary: the highest system_count cell at the finest level for the pinned generation's spatial pyramid, centroid_*; record which cell); (4) the anchored request with the most selective accepted hard filter the route allows at the 500-ly radius and the anchored score-sorted request (sort_by development with reference_coords and max_distance_ly 500) at the densest anchor (read _no_pick_filters for the accepted filters and pick the most selective one; name it). The output's canonical JSON sha256 is the statements digest the receipt records. A test runs the generator against the checkout's apps/api/src (PYTHONPATH) and asserts: statement count 24x3 + 2 + 4 + 2 = 80 (recompute from the list you build and assert the exact number), every sql contains only $n placeholders with n matching params, the picked statements contain the literal floor and the expected <key>_weighted_e4 ORDER BY, and the JSON is deterministic for fixed inputs.

PROBE PROGRAM (scripts/v3_archetype_plan_probe.py). Public entry point run_plan_probe(connection, statements_document, *, generation_id, search_final_insert_at, archetype_final_insert_at, dense_anchor_cell, allow_unpublished=False) -> sealed receipt dict, plus main() for the standalone action. It uses the given psycopg connection (the publish action will pass its own transaction connection; the standalone action passes a read-only connection with default_transaction_read_only on). In order: (i) assert both physical tables' pg_stat_user_tables.last_vacuum AND last_analyze are non-NULL and postdate the given final-insert timestamps (refuse otherwise, exit 20); (ii) SET LOCAL plan_cache_mode = 'force_generic_plan' and SET LOCAL statement_timeout = '60s' (session-level set_config(...,false) when not inside a transaction -- the standalone path -- and SET LOCAL inside the publish transaction; implement as set_config(name, value, is_local) with is_local chosen by the caller); (iii) G = the number of generations holding Search rows, computed WITHOUT scanning the table: for every v3_meta.derived_product row with product_code='system_search', EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM v3_derived.system_search WHERE derived_generation_id=p.derived_generation_id LIMIT 1) -- a primary-key probe -- counting the trues; record G and the generation ids; (iv) for each statement: PREPARE plan_probe_<index>(<param_sql_types>) AS <sql text byte-identical to the generated one>; EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS, FORMAT JSON) EXECUTE plan_probe_<index>(<params rendered with psycopg.sql.Literal>); DEALLOCATE plan_probe_<index>; parse the JSON plan; (v) assert per the design: for picked page statements the window node (the node feeding the LIMIT 10000 over archetype_window) is an Index Only Scan on the index named system_archetype_<key>_<b|a|s>_weighted matching the floor (60->b, 76->a, 88->s) with Actual Rows <= 10001 and Heap Fetches == 0; the sort node's input rows <= 10000; the fetch node's rows <= page_size; for picked counts the archetype scan is an Index Only Scan on that same partial (or an Index Scan on it) under the LIMIT 10001; for EVERY node in any probed plan that reads v3_derived.system_search or v3_derived.system_archetype (Relation Name; the v3_app views expand to these) except the no-pick sentinel count: node type Index Scan or Index Only Scan with Index Name the relation's primary key (system_search_pkey / system_archetype_pkey -- read the actual constraint names from migrations 004 and 011) OR the specific index the bullet names (the picked partial, system_archetype_summary_weighted for the galaxy-wide no-pick page, system_search_position_gist for the anchored requests), and (Actual Rows + Rows Removed by Filter) x Actual Loops <= 10001; any Seq Scan, Bitmap Heap Scan, Bitmap Index Scan, or a Hash/Merge join whose input is either relation fails; for the galaxy-wide no-pick page the window node is an index scan on system_archetype_summary_weighted with <= 10001 rows; for the no-pick sentinel count no node type is prescribed but the plan must contain a Limit node with Plan Rows / actual rows <= 10001 and every node reading either relation satisfies the (rows + removed) x loops <= 10001 bound; for the anchored nearest-first page and count: the KNN scan is an Index Scan on system_search_position_gist under the inner Limit, there is an Incremental Sort node (not a plain Sort) between them, and (Actual Rows + Rows Removed by Filter) x Actual Loops of the KNN scan <= (inner_limit + 1000) x G; for the two anchored requests the inner LIMIT cannot bound: measure the bounding box candidate count with one SELECT count(*) FROM v3_derived.system_search WHERE position_ly <@ <the same cube> (this scan is index-driven; record its count and duration), then require the plan to read system_search only through system_search_position_gist (no Seq Scan anywhere) and (Actual Rows + Rows Removed by Filter) x Actual Loops <= candidate_count x G. Every assertion failure is recorded (statement name, assertion, observed values, the offending node) and the receipt status is failed; the program never stops at the first failure but runs every statement so the receipt is complete. The receipt (sealed via f2d_evidence.seal): schema_version ed-finder/v3-archetype-plan-probe/v1; status passed|failed; ranking_version and ranking_sha256 as the image reported them; statements_sha256; image_digest (passed in by the action); generation identity; G and its generation ids; dense anchor cell and coordinates; per statement: name, kind, sql_sha256, execution_time_ms, planning_time_ms, shared_hit/read blocks of the root node, assertions [{name, passed, observed}], and the full EXPLAIN JSON under plan; vacuum/analyze timestamps checked; f2d_operator_code_sha256; read_only true; db_writes_performed false. Exit codes: 0 passed; 2 identity refusal; 20 vacuum/analyze precondition; 21 statement generation or digest mismatch; 22 one or more plan assertions failed; 23 products not READY/published when allow_unpublished is false (the standalone probe refuses before explaining -- the views would be empty and every plan trivially cheap); 4 database error.

ACTION (scripts/operator/actions/v3-archetype-plan-probe.sh run <REPO_ROOT> <SOURCE_SHA>): identity FIRST; require_target; require_stage (/var/tmp/edfinder-v3-plan-probe-<sha>, marker .v3-plan-probe-source-sha, wheelhouse); require_generation (key, UUID, sequence 1, current, PUBLISHED); require both Finder products READY with published_at IS NOT NULL on the pinned generation (db_query; refuse otherwise with exit 23 passed through); read final_insert_at for both products from the part C build-final receipts (validate their seals with python3.14 on the host; refuse when absent); resolve the active API container, record its image reference AND its RepoDigests / Image digest (docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}' and '{{index .RepoDigests 0}}'), and refuse unless the digest equals the backend image recorded in deploy/v3-production/target-authority.json accepted_release_schema_compatibility.images.backend of the staged checkout (read it with python3.14 json; this is the attested digest until part D2 adds the F2d attestation fields); generate the statements by piping "$REPO_ROOT/scripts/v3_plan_probe_statements.py" into docker exec -i <api container> /app/.venv/bin/python - --dense-anchor <x> <y> <z> (the host resolves the densest cell first through db_query; the generator reads only stdin and its arguments), write the output into the run directory and record its sha256; then run the probe program in a worker container exactly like the capacity gate (API image, /work read-only, wheelhouse psycopg, env-file DSN, --read-only, bounded cpus/memory, timeout 1800 s) with --statements /gate/statements.json --image-digest <digest> --search-final-insert-at ... --archetype-final-insert-at ... --dense-anchor-cell '<json>' --output /gate/receipt.json; print the operation-result envelope with the sealed receipt and exit with the program's code. Read-only throughout: the probe issues PREPARE/EXPLAIN/EXECUTE/DEALLOCATE/SELECT/SET only; a test asserts the program source contains no INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE/TRUNCATE/VACUUM/ALTER/CREATE/DROP and that the connection is read-only in the standalone path.

TESTS. tests/test_v3_archetype_plan_probe.py drives the assertion logic with hand-built EXPLAIN JSON fixtures (no database needed): a conforming picked plan passes; Heap Fetches 1 fails; a Seq Scan on system_search in a picked plan fails; a Bitmap Heap Scan fails; a hash join fed by system_archetype fails; (rows + removed) x loops = 10002 fails and 10001 passes; the galaxy-wide page requires system_archetype_summary_weighted; the sentinel count accepts a Seq Scan capped by a Limit of 10001 but rejects an uncapped scan or a node discarding another generation's rows above the bound; the anchored page requires the GiST index scan, an Incremental Sort, and the (inner_limit + 1000) x G bound with G = 1 and G = 2; the two unbounded anchored requests use candidate_count x G; vacuum/analyze preconditions refuse NULL and predating timestamps; the receipt runs every statement even after a failure and seals; exit codes. A database-backed test on the disposable fixture (through the existing archetype/search fixtures, PostgreSQL 18 in CI; runners have no PostgreSQL -- write it, run what runs, list the rest) runs the generator against the checkout's ranking module, PREPAREs and EXPLAINs every statement against a published fixture generation and checks that the receipt is produced and sealed (plan-shape assertions on a tiny fixture may legitimately fail -- assert only that each statement executed and the receipt records it). tests/test_v3_archetype_plan_probe_operator.py: identity-first, pinned constants, the digest check against target-authority, docker exec -i of the generator, read-only flags, no DML, workflow allowlist.

VALIDATION TO RUN AND REPORT WITH EXACT COUNTS: bash -n on the action; ruff check scripts tests; python -m pytest tests/test_v3_archetype_plan_probe.py tests/test_v3_plan_probe_statements.py tests/test_v3_archetype_plan_probe_operator.py tests/test_f2d_operator_identity.py tests/test_v3_archetype_calibration_probe_operator.py tests/test_python314_execution_surfaces.py -q -p no:warnings; both identity helpers' compute output (equal). Parameterized SQL only (psycopg.sql for identifiers and literals); fail-closed; no deploy, no production access, no production credentials.

IF YOU CANNOT FINISH EVERYTHING IN THIS SESSION, complete in this order and stop cleanly: statement generator + tests; assertion logic + fixture tests; run_plan_probe + receipt; action + workflow wiring + tests. State precisely what remains so part D2 can begin. End with: files changed; tests run with counts; database tests written but not run; the exact statement count; the identity value for the committed tree from both helpers; and any design-versus-code conflict you found.
